name: golden
description: First golden dataset: 42 questions about the Quiz Generation documentation and the AI Guide Gemini upgrade proposal. Key facts are short, exact texts that a correct answer must contain; expected_sources are needed for a complete answer, also_acceptable sources also contain the answer.

items.question: What temperature is the model called with?
items.expected_answer: A low temperature of 0.3, to favor consistent, factual output.

items.question: What happens if the model returns malformed JSON?
items.expected_answer: The system automatically retries the generation, up to 3 times, before failing.

items.question: Which endpoint reports whether Ollama is reachable?
items.expected_answer: GET /health reports whether Ollama is reachable and which model is active.

items.question: Which local model does the quiz project use?
items.expected_answer: qwen2.5:1.5b, run locally through Ollama.

items.question: On which port does the Ollama server run?
items.expected_answer: Port 11434 (http://localhost:11434).

items.question: What difficulty levels can a quiz have?
items.expected_answer: easy, medium or hard.

items.question: How many options does each multiple choice question have?
items.expected_answer: Exactly 4 options, with exactly one correct answer.

items.question: What HTTP status code is returned when Ollama is down?
items.expected_answer: 503 (OllamaUnavailableError).

items.question: Which command starts the API server?
items.expected_answer: uvicorn app.main:app --reload

items.question: Which module does the current AI Guide chat always recommend?
items.expected_answer: Always "breathwork", regardless of context.

items.question: In the proposed design, what happens if the Gemini call fails?
items.expected_answer: The chat silently falls back to the existing random generic (canned) reply; no error is shown to the user.

items.question: Why not use a cloud AI provider like OpenAI for the quiz project?
items.expected_answer: Running Ollama locally needs no API keys or billing, keeps quiz data private, works offline and small models run on modest hardware.

items.question: Will the endpoints change when Gemini is added to the AI Guide chat?
items.expected_answer: No. The API surface does not change: same endpoints and the same request/response shape.

items.question: What is wrong with the replies the AI Guide chat gives today?
items.expected_answer: They are not AI-generated: one of three hardcoded sentences is picked at random, with no memory of the conversation and no relationship to what the user wrote.

items.question: How does the system stop the model from making up facts in quiz questions?
items.expected_answer: Prompts explicitly tell the model to avoid inventing facts and stay on topic; a low temperature (0.3) also favors factual output.

items.question: What does the API do if I ask for 25 questions?
items.expected_answer: It rejects the request with HTTP 400, because num_questions must be between 1 and 20.

items.question: If I ask for 10 questions across three quiz types, how are they divided?
items.expected_answer: As evenly as possible: 4, 3 and 3.

items.question: Why could sending a chat message take longer once Gemini is added?
items.expected_answer: Each message now waits for a real Gemini-backed reply, so latency per message is slightly higher.

also_acceptable.section: One thing to keep in mind

items.question: Can I switch the quiz project to another model without changing the code?
items.expected_answer: Yes. The model name lives in the .env file, so switching (e.g. to gemma2:2b) only needs a config change.

items.question: for whom the file is prepared?
items.expected_answer: The AI Guide proposal is prepared for the Engineering Lead Review.
items.notes: Real user question that was wrongly answered 'not found' before RERANK_MIN_BEST_SCORE was added.

items.question: how i run the projct
items.expected_answer: Install Ollama and pull qwen2.5:1.5b, create a venv, pip install -r requirements.txt, then run uvicorn app.main:app --reload.

items.question: wat happens when ollama is not reachable
items.expected_answer: An OllamaUnavailableError is raised and mapped to HTTP 503.

items.question: max how much questions i can generate
items.expected_answer: Up to 20 questions per request (num_questions must be between 1 and 20).

items.question: Which quiz types are supported and how do I run the project?
items.expected_answer: MCQ, Short Answer and Fill in the Blank (also mixed). To run: install Ollama, pull the model, install requirements, start uvicorn.

items.question: What does GET /health do, and what does GET /models do?
items.expected_answer: /health reports whether Ollama is reachable and which model is active; /models lists all models available in the local Ollama installation.

items.question: In the AI Guide proposal, what happens to the escalation check and to recommended_module_slug?
items.expected_answer: The escalation check stays unchanged, deterministic and runs first; recommended_module_slug is dropped (left empty) for Gemini replies.

items.question: What temperature does the quiz model use, and how many times does it retry on failure?
items.expected_answer: Temperature 0.3; it retries up to 3 times.

items.question: What is the requests library used for in the quiz project?
items.expected_answer: It is the HTTP client that communicates with the local Ollama server.

items.question: Which server runs the FastAPI application?
items.expected_answer: Uvicorn, an ASGI server.

items.question: In the AI Guide proposal, how does conversation memory differ between the current and the proposed version?
items.expected_answer: Current: none, each message is treated in isolation. Proposed: recent message history is passed to Gemini.

items.question: In the AI Guide proposal, which files change in the code?
items.expected_answer: integrations/ai/gemini_client.py, services/ai_guide_service.py and routes/ai_guide.py.

items.question: According to the quiz project documentation, what improvements are planned for the future?
items.expected_answer: A web frontend, saving quizzes to a database, automated tests, Docker, and per-type question counts for mixed quizzes.

items.question: In the AI Guide proposal, why should usage be monitored once the chat is live?
items.expected_answer: Chat can be called many times per conversation, so cost and latency scale with message volume.

expected_sources.section: One thing to keep in mind

items.notes: The proposal says cost should be monitored, but gives no price.

history.question: What happens in the AI Guide chat when a crisis message is detected?
history.answer: A fixed safe/support message is returned and is_escalation is set to true.
